meaning: Pullback square mediator uniqueness and ambiguous interface factorization benchmark across 5 model families (Theorem 90): Phase 1 separates coarse cospan mismatches f(a0) = c_even != c_odd = g(b1) (Delta_E = -1); Phase 2 separates non-injective coarse interface fibers over c_even with fiber size 2 * 2 = 4 > 1 mixing (a0, b0) and (a0, b2) (Delta_E = -1); Phase 3 verifies refined singleton-fiber interface with fiber size 1 and unique universal cone mediator u(w_i) = [a_i, b_i] (Delta_E = 0).
